title: Week 3 review — databases, DR, migration, hybrid networking

answers.explanation: Classic 3-tier: ALB in public subnets (IGW route); app and Aurora in private — night-22 Block 1 architecture.
Lambda VPC cold start attaches ENI — first invoke often times out; second succeeds — Night 17 lab note.
Aurora Multi-AZ = synchronous storage failover; standby is not for analytics reads — Night 15.
PITR restores to a new table within 35 days — original unchanged — Night 18.
Backup and restore = lowest cost, hours RTO — DR ladder Night 19.
DMS cutover pattern = full load then CDC tailing WAL/binlog — Night 20.
Site-to-Site VPN = IPSec over internet, hours to stand up — Night 21 quick hybrid.
NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES for diffing old vs new viewCount — Night 18 stream view types.
S3 Gateway endpoint on private route table — Night 8/10; no NAT toll for S3.
RDS Proxy pools Lambda connection storms — Night 15 theory.
Transit Gateway hub-spoke for multi-VPC + on-prem — Night 21 Scenario 2.
Tag-based backup selection auto-enrolls new matching resources — Night 19 lab.
PrivateLink = consumer interface endpoint to provider NLB — no full VPC peering — Night 21.
DynamoDB export = snapshot to S3; not live CDC — Night 20 lab distinction.
DX primary + Site-to-Site VPN backup to same TGW/VGW — Night 21 resilient hybrid pair.
Aurora Global Database for sub-second cross-Region RPO — Night 15/19; not promote replica alone.
VPC peering is non-transitive — A-B + B-C does not route A-C — Night 21.
Aurora SG allows lambda-stats-sg on 5432 — Night 16/17 lab pattern.
Snowball for offline bulk seed when network is too slow — Night 20.
Warm standby = scaled-down live DR; lower RTO than pilot light — Night 19 DR ladder.
SCT for heterogeneous Oracle → PostgreSQL before DMS — Night 20.
Overlapping CIDR blocks break hybrid routing — Night 21 exam trap.
SQS visibility timeout ≥ Lambda timeout — Night 17 flashcard.
CloudTrail logs API calls; AWS Backup stores recovery points — Night 19.
Serverless v2 has minimum ACU — no scale-to-zero — Night 15/16.
DX is private not encrypted by default — add VPN over DX if required — Night 21.
DynamoDB counters vs Aurora relational JOINs — GSA split across Week 3.
Wait for CDC lag ≈ 0 after stopping writes before cutover — Night 20 cutover checklist.
Client VPN = per-user remote access; Site-to-Site = whole DC — Night 21.
Teardown Lambda (Night 17) then Aurora (Night 16); keep VPC for Week 4 — night-22 teardown table.
